reason: In uploads_controller.rb:63-67 the patch adds a loop that runs at most 5 times, calling OptimizedImage.downsize(..., "80%") while the file is still over max_image_size_kb. Each call goes through optimize/convert_with (optimized_image.rb:153-165), which runs a `convert` shell command (gifsicle for animated GIFs) and then ImageOptim.optimize_image!. The upload size limit is now a hardcoded 10 MB in utilities.js:182/246 and in FileHelper.download at uploads_controller.rb:55.
